United States.title: Russian Diplomat Ejected from Washington After Confrontation
United States.summary: A senior Russian diplomat was ejected from the United States after a confrontation with a State Department security officer. The incident occurred on July 24, 2024, at the Russian Embassy in Washington, D.C. The diplomat's actions were deemed a threat to safety, leading to his removal from the country.

United States.title: US-China Trade Tensions Escalate Over Rare Earth Export
United States.summary: Tensions between the United States and China have escalated over the export of rare earth minerals. China has restricted the export of these critical minerals, which are essential for the production of advanced technologies. The move has raised concerns about the impact on the global supply chain and has sparked fears of a renewed trade war between the two nations.

United States.title: Gun Laws to Get Review After Texas Mass Shooting
United States.summary: Following a recent mass shooting in Texas, President Biden has announced plans to review and potentially reform gun laws in the United States. The president has expressed his commitment to taking action to reduce gun violence and prevent such tragedies from occurring in the future.

South Korea.title: North Korea says new Covid-19 cases found, but still no outbreaks: KCNA
South Korea.summary: SEOUL - North Korea reported new Covid-19 cases in a recent outbreak but has no symptoms of the disease, the official KCNA news agency reported on Tuesday.

South Korea.title: North Korea's Kim orders more lockdowns to curb COVID-19 spread
South Korea.summary: SEOUL (Reuters) - North Korean leader Kim Jong Un ordered more lockdowns to control the spread of COVID-19, state media said on Sunday, as the country reported 8,180 new cases over the past week.

South Korea.title: North Korea fires ballistic missile off east coast, Japan Coast Guard says
South Korea.summary: The Japan Coast Guard said that North Korea fired a ballistic missile off its east coast on Thursday.
